_comment: Explicit test-selection overrides layered on top of the automatic consumer graph. Keys and values are matched case-insensitively.

_schema.include: Subprojects to add that cannot be derived as same-stage consumers from RUNTIME_DEPS/BUILD_DEPS. Covers: (a) test-only projects with no link-time dep edge (e.g. hip-tests, rocgdb-cpu), and (b) same-stage reverse edges not present as forward consumers.
_schema.exclude: Subprojects to remove even though they appear as consumers in the graph (e.g. to avoid expensive suites for low-risk changes). Applied after include AND after fanout_all_consumers, so it can prune a specific consumer from a fanned-out foundational dep.
_schema.fanout_all_consumers: Boolean. When true, a change to this project selects ALL of its graph consumers, bypassing the same-stage cut. This is the opt-in for foundational deps that have no derivable build stage (rocm-core, rocm-cmake, ...) whose consumers span every stage; the same-stage cut would otherwise select nothing for them. The consumer names are read live from therock_consumer_graph.json, so they stay in sync automatically as the graph changes. Must stay explicit per project: blanket-fanning every stage-less project would re-expand universal deps (hip-clr, therock-googletest) into the whole test tree.
_schema._note_cross_stage: Cross-stage 'universal' consumers of hip-clr / ROCR-Runtime (~28 each) are intentionally NOT enumerated here. A change to those triggers a broad rebuild; enumerating their consumers would recreate the whole-tree test explosion the bounded same-stage design exists to prevent.
